name: freight-reconciliation
description: Payer-side freight reconciliation expert: import carrier bills and trip ledgers into a deterministic local core (SQLite, no cloud), re-calculate against contracted rates, and produce evidence-linked difference lists for human review. Never approves payments, never sends anything; final confirmations route through a local admin page. MCP server pinned via uvx to the immutable commit harrylabsj/freight-reconciliation@53a01c275377115ea9abd6de8e2df47fcc06b04e (release v0.4.0).
